Title: Surface structured application and Windows Event Logs in admin diagnostics with search and filtering.
Description: MemorySmith has a health page and an admin diagnostics endpoint, but neither currently exposes application log events as first-class operational data. Add an admin-safe log surface that can read configured structured sinks and Windows Event Log records relevant to MemorySmith, then support filtering by level, time range, correlation id, area, and free-text query. Windows Event Log ingestion should be on by default on Windows and switchable off from settings. Acceptance criteria: administrators can inspect recent app and event-log records from the product, narrow results without shell access, copy correlation ids or event metadata for debugging and incident triage, and control log-source toggles and retention/query limits from the existing admin configuration interface. Validation: emit sample informational and error events, including an entry that lands in Windows Event Log, retrieve them through the diagnostics surface using structured filters and text search, then disable event-log source reading via admin settings and verify the diagnostics view reflects the change.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/DiagnosticsController.cs` exposes operational diagnostics and measurement baseline only, and `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/HealthStats.razor` renders stats/configuration cards but no searchable application-log view.
